result.name: Dvije obale — Two Shores
result.oneLiner: A limewash-and-Adriatic single page built on Mon Ami's actual geography: the family's olive grove in Skradin and the fields of Turopolje meeting at one table on the main square of Velika Gorica.
result.rationale:
Every fine-dining site defaults to black, and black is exactly wrong here. Mon Ami is not a hushed tasting room — it is a bright, busy, 70-seat family house on a town square where a waiter in white gloves carries a platter of grilled squid past three men toasting with sparkling wine. Critically, the restaurant's own best photographs are already shot on black reflective surfaces (gallery 18, 21, 40; the steak hero IMG_1935bbb). If the page is also black, that photography disappears into the background. So the ground here is limewashed Dalmatian plaster — warm cream oklch(0.972 0.010 84) — and those dark food photographs become deep saturated blocks against it. The photography supplies the drama; the layout stays calm, rooted and generous.

The organising idea is the founding fact itself, which nothing currently online uses: Božo Ceronja from the Skradin area married Barica, a native Turopoljka, and put the Adriatic and the continental interior on one menu — "prava mala revolucija" in 1990s Velika Gorica. That is a real structural narrative, not a mood board. So the page runs on a literal north–south meridian: a hairline rule down the full page with two marked nodes, Skradin 43.81° N (the olive grove) and Velika Gorica 45.71° N (the restaurant), the gradient between them running Adriatic blue → olive green → olive-oil gold. Sections alternate shores: daily catch (sea — the one dark band), olive grove and Skradinska torta (coast), Turopolje truffle and the named OPGs Balić / Haha / Goga (interior).

It also fixes every real failure in the dossier instead of decorating around them: hours rendered from one JS object that also emits the JSON-LD, a genuine HTML menu with all 60 priced dishes, an honest per-kilogram explanation so €96 reads as generosity rather than error, the twenty gallery photographs that have never been published, and a booking route that is not "read a phone number off a contact page". Premium and current — but warm enough that you would bring your parents.

palette.use: Body background. Limewashed Dalmatian plaster; warm, never blue-white. Carries a 4%-opacity SVG salt-grain overlay tiled at 180x180px so it never reads as flat #FFF.
All body text and headlines on Sol. A sea-stone near-black with a blue cast, not neutral grey. 14.6:1 on Sol — clears 1.4.3 AA and AAA.
English dish translations, captions, metadata, hours-table day labels. 6.4:1 on Sol — still clears AA for normal text.
Meridian gradient midpoint, rule accents, the plate-O mark, hairline underlines, olive-grove section wash. Never small text on Sol (2.4:1 — decorative only, 1.4.3 incidental).
The darkened gold used wherever gold must be read: kickers, links, Skradin/olive labels. 5.2:1 on Sol. This pairing lets the brand colour appear as type without failing contrast.
Background of the single dark band (#ulov, the daily catch) and the footer. Deep sea at dusk, not corporate navy. Sol text on it reads 10.9:1.
Meridian gradient top stop, hover tints via color-mix, the 'Danas otvoreno' open-state pill fill, allergen/diet chip fills.
Evolved from the legacy brand #b22047 into something wine-dark and less 2019-magenta. Primary CTA fill ('Rezerviraj stol'), light-mode focus ring, distinction rules. Sol on Kupa = 8.1:1.
Reservation-dialog ground, 'preporuka šefa' badge fill, pull-quote background. Kamen on it = 12.9:1.
Olive-grove section rule and leaf mark, 'vlastito' provenance chips, vegetarian/vegan diet tags, supplier-grid hairlines. 5.0:1 on Sol.
Dark-mode body ground. The dining room after 20:00 — deep sea-stone, never pure black, never neutral. Cream text at 12.8:1.
Every rule, table divider and card edge. Declared once as a token; in dark mode the mix swaps to var(--sol) 22%. Dividers that carry meaning get a 3:1 variant per 1.4.11.

typography.displayFont: Fraunces — variable, axes wght 300–700, opsz 9–144, SOFT 0–40, WONK 0–1. Set at wght 400 / opsz 144 / SOFT 30 / WONK 1 for h1–h2, wght 500 / opsz 24 / WONK 0 for dish names and prices, italic 300 for pull-quotes.
typography.bodyFont: Instrument Sans — weights 400, 500, 600 plus 400 italic. All body copy, labels, buttons, nav, English translations, micro-type.
typography.pairingRationale: Fraunces is an old-style with a genuinely hand-cut feel: its SOFT axis rounds the terminals and WONK swaps in flared, slightly irregular alternates, so it reads as chisel and oak rather than as another luxury-brand Didone. That matters because Mon Ami's own copy says 'interijer je sadržan od prirodnih materijala' and MICHELIN names local oak, marble and stone. At opsz 144 it can carry a whole cream screen with no photograph behind it, which is the central visual bet of this design. Instrument Sans is the counterweight: a neutral, slightly condensed grotesque with a tall x-height and narrow set width — exactly what 60 dish names need in a grid where 'Pljukanci od špinata sa škampima, pestom od sušenih rajčica i tostiranim pistacijom' must not wrap three times. Both ship a latin-ext subset on Google Fonts, so č ć đ š ž arrive in the same request — non-negotiable, since Škampi, Blitva, Ražnjić, Beus and Graševina all break under a latin-only subset. Load as ONE stylesheet <link> with display=swap, preconnect to fonts.gstatic.com with crossorigin, preload only Fraunces (the h1 is the LCP text). Pair each with a size-adjust @font-face fallback (Fraunces → Georgia ≈ size-adjust: 103%; Instrument Sans → Arial ≈ size-adjust: 96%) generated with Fontaine rather than guessed, to hold font-swap CLS near zero.
typography.scale: Fluid clamps derived slope/intercept between 320px (20rem) and 1440px (90rem); every preferred value contains a rem term so browser text-zoom still scales (Roselli rule — never a bare vw). h1: clamp(2.75rem, 1.54rem + 6.07vw, 7rem) / line-height 0.94 / letter-spacing -0.02em / text-wrap: balance. h2: clamp(2rem, 1.50rem + 2.50vw, 3.75rem) / lh 1.02 / ls -0.015em / text-wrap: balance. h3: clamp(1.375rem, 1.23rem + 0.71vw, 1.875rem) / lh 1.15. Lede and pull-quote: clamp(1.25rem, 1.14rem + 0.54vw, 1.625rem) / lh 1.45 / max-inline-size 46ch. Body: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.03rem + 0.18vw, 1.1875rem) / lh 1.60 / max-inline-size 68ch. Small and labels: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.79rem + 0.09vw, 0.875rem) / lh 1.4; kickers add letter-spacing 0.14em + uppercase. Prices, hours and coordinates use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums. Section rhythm: padding-block clamp(4.5rem, 9vw, 9rem); page gutter clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem); content max-inline-size 78rem.

sections.title: Sticky rail + language toggle
sections.purpose: Persistent orientation, instant booking, HR/EN switch, dark-mode switch. Must never obscure keyboard focus (WCAG 2.4.11).
sections.layout: Height 4.5rem, position: sticky; inset-block-start: 0; z-index 50. Background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sol) 82%, transparent) with backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2) plus -webkit- prefix; a 1px bottom Rub hairline appears only once scrolled, toggled by an IntersectionObserver sentinel at the top of the hero adding .is-stuck. Three-column grid: [logo lockup] [nav links, centred] [actions]. Logo is an inline SVG redraw of the MON AMI wordmark with the O as a plate ring — must be redrawn because logo-monami.png has a baked cream wood-grain background and sp.png is a 115-byte spacer, not artwork. Links: Jelovnik · Ulov · Maslinik · Prostor · Posjet at 0.875rem Instrument Sans 500, letter-spacing 0.06em, each with a 1px Ulje underline that scaleX-grows from the left on hover/focus (transform-origin: left; 180ms). Actions: an [HR|EN] segmented toggle with aria-pressed and 44px targets, a sun/moon icon button, and 'Rezerviraj' as a solid Kupa pill (0.75rem 1.5rem, border-radius 999px). Below 48rem the links collapse into a <button popovertarget> light-dismiss popover panel (popover, not dialog — it is navigation, not a form) and the Rezerviraj pill moves to a fixed bottom bar with 'Nazovi', padding-block-end: max(0.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), hidden at ≥48rem, with matching body padding so it never covers the footer. Set scroll-padding-block-start: 5.5rem and scroll-padding-block-end: 5rem on :root (technique C43).
sections.copyDirection: Nav labels stay single Croatian words so the bar never wraps: Jelovnik · Ulov · Maslinik · Prostor · Posjet, with EN mapping to Menu · Catch · Olive grove · The room · Visit. CTA reads 'Rezerviraj stol' in full at ≥64rem and 'Rezerviraj' below it; EN 'Book a table'. The toggle is labelled 'HR' / 'EN' with a visually hidden 'Promijeni jezik / Change language'. Mobile bottom bar carries exactly two actions and no more: 'Rezerviraj' and 'Nazovi 01 6213 333'.

sections.title: Hero — the meridian opens
sections.purpose:
In seven seconds: who, what, where, the distinction, today's hours with a live open/closed state, and two real CTAs. Must beat the current homepage's literal empty

.
sections.layout: min-block-size: min(100svh, 52rem); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,0.92fr) at ≥64rem, single column below. LEFT (cream, no photo): kicker 'VELIKA GORICA · OD 1997.' in Ulje-tamni; h1 on two lines — 'Dvije obale,' / 'jedan stol.' — at the full 7rem clamp with WONK 1, the comma and full stop hanging into the gutter via a negative text-indent on line two; lede at 46ch. Beneath, a 'distinction rule': a 1px Rub line carrying three inline text items with 1.5rem gaps — 'MICHELIN Guide 2026 · Selected', 'Gault&Millau 13,5/20 · 2 toque', '#1 u Velikoj Gorici' — as type, never as scraped logos (trademark risk), each linking to its source. Then the live status pill: a 6px dot plus 'Danas otvoreno do 23:00' computed in JS from the hours object, Jadran-plitko fill when open, Rub outline when closed, with today's exact line beneath in Kamen-meko. Two CTAs: primary Kupa 'Rezerviraj stol'; secondary ghost-outline tel:+38516213333 shown as '01 6213 333'. RIGHT: image bleeding to the right viewport edge, aspect-ratio 4/5 desktop, 3/2 mobile, border-radius 2px only (stone, not SaaS). Use gallery/12.jpg — grilled squid on a white oval platter in white-gloved hands — because it shows service in a real room, not an empty studio plate. <picture> with AVIF/WebP/JPEG, explicit width/height, fetchpriority="high", never lazy, and the only high-priority image on the page. Overlapping its bottom-left corner at -1.5rem, a small cream caption card. The meridian hairline starts here: a 1px absolutely positioned vertical line in the left gutter, linear-gradient(to bottom, Jadran-plitko, Ulje), continuing down the document.
sections.copyDirection: HR h1 'Dvije obale, jedan stol.' Lede: 'Od 1997. obitelj Ceronja spaja jadransku ribu i turopoljsko polje na istom jelovniku — u središtu Velike Gorice, tri minute od autobusnog kolodvora i nadomak zračne luke.' Status strings: 'Danas otvoreno do 23:00' / 'Danas otvoreno do 16:30' / 'Danas zatvoreno — otvaramo u utorak u 11:00'. Caption card: 'Jadranske lignje sa žara — s blitvom i krumpirom'. EN h1 'Two shores, one table.' Do not write 'Tradicija duga 25 godina' — it is stale; write 'Od 1997.' and let the reader do the arithmetic, or 'gotovo trideset godina' sourced to MICHELIN's own 'nearly thirty years'.

sections.title: Priča — the two-shores story
sections.purpose: Convert the founding fact into the emotional spine. This is what the current /o-nama gestures at and never lands.
sections.layout: Asymmetric two-column grid at ≥64rem: 5fr text / 7fr images. Text column: h2 'Skradin i Turopolje, pod istim krovom', three paragraphs at 68ch, and a Fraunces-italic pull-quote in a Kupa-svijetli block with a 2px Kupa left border — 'prava mala revolucija' — attributed to Bruno Ceronja. Image column is a deliberate diptych expressing the thesis: LEFT gallery/03.jpg (the Mon Ami olive-oil bottles against exposed brick) at 3/4, RIGHT gallery/28.jpg (fish steaks on a charcoal grill, flames and smoke) at 3/4, offset vertically by 4rem so they interlock rather than sit as a neat pair. A hairline Ulje rule connects them with two 4px dots labelled in 0.6875rem tabular-nums: '43,81° N SKRADIN' and '45,71° N VELIKA GORICA'. Below, three stat cells in a subgrid so figures and labels align exactly: '1997 · godina osnutka', '70 + 20 · mjesta u sali i na terasi', '≈100 km · radijus nabave'.
sections.copyDirection: Plain Croatian, real story: Božo Ceronja iz skradinskog kraja i Barica, rođena Turopoljka, otvorili su restoran 1997. i stavili more i kopno na isti jelovnik — u gradu koji je tada jeo s roštilja. Danas ga vodi njihov sin Bruno s majkom. Name chef Goran Marko Beus here with his actual biography: rodom iz Splita, sedamnaest godina na čelu kuhinje, karijera na dalmatinskoj obali i na brodovima. Close on the house motto set apart in Fraunces italic: 'kao prijatelj prijatelju'.

sections.title: Ulov — the daily catch (the one dark band)
sections.purpose: Explain the by-weight fresh-fish model honestly, so €96 reads as a whole Kvarner langoustine rather than a pricing error. Also the page's single tonal shift.
sections.layout: Full-bleed Jadran band, padding-block: clamp(5rem, 10vw, 10rem); the meridian hairline switches to Jadran-plitko inside it. Kicker 'RIBA' in Jadran-plitko, h2 'Riba dolazi tri puta tjedno' in Sol. Left column: body copy plus a species list as inline chips rather than bullets — škrpina · brancin · kovač · zubatac · sabljarka · crna orada — each a 1px Sol-25% outline, 0.375rem 0.875rem, border-radius 2px. Right column: gallery/05.jpg (platter of whole fresh fish with langoustines and lemon) at 5/4. Below both, the price-honesty block: three cards, each with dish name, the figure in 2rem Fraunces tabular-nums, and a Sol-70% line reading '/ kg — vaga se pred vama' — Jadranske lignje 62,00 €, Škampi (8–12 kom/kg) 96,00 €, Školjke na buzaru 63,00 €. One full-width sentence decodes the grading notation. The band uses content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size to stay out of initial layout cost.
sections.copyDirection: 'Brodovi ne isplovljavaju svaki dan, pa radimo s više ribara. Riba stiže tri puta tjedno i važe se pred vama — zato je cijena po kilogramu, a ne po porciji.' Decode the grading plainly: '8–12 kom/kg označava veličinu: osam do dvanaest škampa čini kilogram. Veći škamp, manje komada.' Quote MICHELIN in English with attribution and give our own Croatian rendering beneath in smaller type, explicitly marked as our translation: 'Fish takes center stage in simple, traditional recipes that highlight the quality of the ingredients.'

sections.title: Jelovnik — the full priced menu in HTML
sections.purpose: Fix the single biggest failure on the current site: there is no menu page at all. All 60 dishes, in HTML, indexable, styled, Croatian primary and English secondary.
sections.layout: Sticky sub-nav of category chips (BEST BUY · Hladna predjela · Topla predjela, tjestenine i rižota · Kruh i umaci · Jela od mesa · Jela od riba · Prilozi · Salate · Slastice · Bez glutena · Vegetarijanski), horizontally scrollable on mobile with scroll-snap-type: x proximity and visible prev/next buttons (WCAG 2.5.7 — never swipe-only). Each category is a <section> with an h3 and a dish list. The dish grid is the technical centrepiece: ul { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(21rem, 1fr)); gap: 0 clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem) } with each li { display: grid; grid-template-rows: subgrid; grid-row: span 3 } so dish name, English line and price share baselines across independent columns. Per dish: name in Fraunces 500 with a dotted Rub leader to a tabular-nums price; English beneath in Instrument Sans 400 italic Kamen-meko (hidden under lang=en, where it becomes primary); then diet/flag chips carrying BOTH icon and text — 'bez glutena', 'vegetarijansko', 'preporuka šefa', 'posebna ponuda' — never icon-only. The five chef's-recommendation dishes get a Kupa-svijetli card wash. Six dishes carry a thumbnail from the Restaumatic photography; the rest are text-only, which reads as confidence. Container queries (@container (inline-size > 34rem)) decide whether the English line sits beneath or inline. Foot of section: a 'Cijene se mogu mijenjati — posljednje ažuriranje' date line and a link to the printable PDF, finally surfaced.
sections.copyDirection: Croatian dish names exactly as the kitchen writes them; English rewritten properly — the platform's 'Prshutto', 'french frie', 'homemaid', 'cackerels', 'bouzzara' and the mis-mapped 'Beefsteak salad' are unusable. Use 'Prosciutto', 'Fried sand smelt', 'Scampi buzara', 'Istrian fuži with beefsteak and black truffle'. Section intro: 'Jelovnik se mijenja sa sezonom i s ulovom. Dnevnu ponudu ribe pitajte osoblje.' Give Skradinska torta two extra lines under Slastice: 'Bez brašna, s bademima, narančom i orasima — po kraju iz kojeg dolazi obitelj.'

sections.title: Maslinik — our olive grove in Skradin
sections.purpose: Own the most distinctive asset Mon Ami has and MICHELIN never mentions: a restaurant that presses its own gold-medal oil.
sections.layout: Ulje-washed band — background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ulje) 10%, var(--sol)) — with an olive-branch line-drawing SVG at 6% opacity bleeding off the right edge. Grid 6fr image / 6fr text. Image is gallery/14.jpg (the dark ceramic amphora pouring oil onto a white plate, lobster and scorpionfish behind), the richest frame in the library. Text: kicker 'VLASTITA PROIZVODNJA', h2 'Ulje iz našeg maslinika u Skradinu', body, then a three-row spec table in subgrid with hairline dividers — 'Sorta — Oblica', 'Maslinik — Skradin, OPG Ceronja', 'Priznanje — zlatno odličje, 96,42 boda, Dani mladih maslinovih ulja, Vodice'. Below, three Maslina-outlined product chips: 'ekstra djevičansko ulje', 'hrvatske zelene masline', 'čaj od maslina', with a line noting they can be bought in the restaurant. A boxed 0.8125rem Kamen-meko caveat states that the grove and the medals are the restaurant's own claim, distinct from the MICHELIN listing — legally clean and it reads as confidence, not hedging.
sections.copyDirection: Use chef Beus's own line, attributed: 'Bez njega ne možemo ni zamisliti kuhinju.' Give his definition of Mediterranean cooking — kvalitetno ulje, svježe voće i povrće, što manje termičke obrade. Mention that the whole team does the olive and grape harvest together. Never write or imply that MICHELIN praised the oil.

sections.title: Kopno — Turopolje truffle and the neighbours
sections.purpose: The second shore. Turns an abstract 'local sourcing' claim into three named farms and one specific truffle.
sections.layout: Cream ground, no photograph competing — this section is typographic on purpose, resting the eye between two image-heavy bands. Centred h2 'Crni turopoljski tartuf i tri susjeda' at 24ch with text-wrap: balance. A three-column supplier grid, each cell with a 1px Maslina top hairline, a small Fraunces numeral (01/02/03), the producer in Fraunces 500, what they supply and where: OPG Balić — med, Žumberačko gorje; OPG Haha — lješnjaci i pasta od lješnjaka, Turopolje; OPG Goga — kruške, Turopolje. Beneath, a wide single-column block on the truffle: the switch from Istrian to native Turopolje truffle, served daily year-round, grated at the table, and that a guest can order a day ahead and grate it themselves. Right-aligned inside that block, a small dish card — Carpacio od tune s crnim tartufom, 18,50 € — using the Restaumatic dish photo. Close with the semifreddo story as a Fraunces-italic quote attributed to chef Beus via MICHELIN.
sections.copyDirection: 'Sve što može biti lokalno koristimo u kuhinji' — Bruno Ceronja. Name the suppliers plainly; the specificity is the luxury. One honest sentence on the truffle: it is native, it is Turopolje's, and it is on the table every day of the year. Then the semifreddo: honey from OPG Balić, hazelnuts from OPG Haha, pears from OPG Goga — 'a true celebration of the land around us.'

sections.title: Prostor — the room, the terrace, the separe
sections.purpose: Show the room in service, never empty, and answer the practical questions a family or a business host actually has.
sections.layout: A masonry-feel CSS grid, not a carousel (carousels are dated and drag-only fails 2.5.7). grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr) with six hand-placed cells of varied span and aspect ratio: onama2.jpg (waiter serving, guests toasting — span 7, 16/10); gallery/01.jpg (the empty room with pendant lamps and oak beams — span 5, 4/5); gallery/30.jpg (chef holding an octopus, the library's only portrait frame — span 4, 3/4); gallery/25.jpg (female chef plating grilled octopus — span 4, 1/1); onama1.jpg (sommelier before the wine wall — span 4, 3/4); gallery/40.jpg (chocolate-glazed torte — span 6, 21/9 crop). Every image gets a real Croatian alt — the current gallery's forty empty alts and '01'–'40' titles are the accessibility failure this section exists to repair. A tile opens a <dialog> lightbox via showModal() for focus trapping, with a same-document View Transition on the image, guarded by @supports and prefers-reduced-motion. Beneath the grid, three fact cards with hairline tops: 'Sala — 70 mjesta', 'Separe — 10 mjesta, zatvorena poslovna druženja', 'Terasa — oko 20 mjesta, natkrivena i grijana'. Then a short events line linking into the enquiry dialog.
sections.copyDirection: Quote the restaurant's own sentence because it is genuinely good: 'Interijer je sadržan od prirodnih materijala koji predstavljaju naš pristup življenju i poslovanju.' Add MICHELIN's material detail — hrastovi stolovi, mramor i kamen — in our own words. Events line: 'Poslovna druženja, svadbe, pričesti, krizme i krštenja, tematske večeri.' State the 70-seat limit honestly rather than implying unlimited wedding capacity.

sections.title: Vino — 60 labels and a wine of our own
sections.purpose: A 60-label Croatian list and a house cuvée the family actually produces are currently invisible online. Give them a section without inventing prices that do not exist.
sections.layout: Split band: left 5fr a Jadran-tinted card holding the house wine as a hero item — 'Vino kuće · cuvée Chardonnay – Graševina', beneath it 'podregija Pokuplje, vinogorje Vukomeričke gorice' in tabular small caps, plus a one-line note that the restaurant produces it itself. Right 7fr: onama1.jpg, the sommelier before the wine shelf. Below the split, one honest row — '60 etiketa, poglavito hrvatskih proizvođača' and 'Sommelier — Zlatko Šimac' — and a <details>/<summary> disclosure 'Nekoliko etiketa s karte' listing only the three documented wines (Krauthaker Graševina Mitrovac, Pjenušac Poy – Mladina, Plešivica, and the house cuvée) with no prices, closing with an invitation to phone. No fabricated wine list: the dossier is explicit that none is published.
sections.copyDirection: 'Vinska karta broji 60 etiketa, poglavito vina hrvatskih proizvođača. Vino kuće proizvodimo sami.' Then Gault&Millau in English with attribution: 'The wine list offers selected labels from Croatian vineyards, and the service deserves special praise.' Close: 'Za cijelu kartu i preporuku uz vaš izbor — nazovite nas.'

sections.title: Posjet — hours, address, getting here, booking
sections.purpose: Every practical fact currently trapped on one stale page, plus the reservation route the site has never had.
sections.layout: Three columns at ≥64rem collapsing to one. COLUMN 1 — hours as a real <table> with a <caption>, one row per day, today's row marked with a Ulje left border and aria-current="date": Pon 11:00–16:30 / Uto–Sub 11:00–23:00 / Ned zatvoreno / Blagdani zatvoreno. Rendered from a single JS hours object that also generates the openingHoursSpecification in the JSON-LD, so the two can never drift. COLUMN 2 — address as selectable text (Trg kralja Tomislava 26, 10410 Velika Gorica), tel: and mailto: links with 44px targets, and an 'Otvori u Google kartama' outbound link. Deliberately no embedded Maps iframe — an LCP liability and a third-party-cookie problem. In its place an inline SVG mini-map showing the main square, the bus station and a three-minute walk line: on-brand and weightless. COLUMN 3 — arrival: airport bus every 35 minutes for about €2, three minutes on foot from the bus station, parking on the square, Bolt e-scooters nearby, plus wheelchair access, air conditioning, no pets, no smoking. Spanning all three beneath, the reservation block: 'Rezerviraj stol' opens a <dialog> via showModal() containing a short form (ime, broj osoba, datum, vrijeme, telefon, napomena — alergije, dječji stolac, separe) with field-sizing: content on the textarea and @starting-style plus transition-behavior: allow-discrete on display and overlay for the fade-and-rise. The phone number sits beside the form at equal weight, because for a 70-seat family restaurant the phone is still the real booking channel. An explicit large-party/events line opens the same dialog with the type preselected.
sections.copyDirection: Render the per-day table and never the site's own overriding sentence 'svaki dan osim nedjelje' — a guest who reads that arrives Monday at 19:00 to a locked door. Booking copy: 'Rezervacija je poželjna. Za veće grupe i proslave javite se unaprijed.' Arrival copy in both languages, since the airport-traveller audience is explicitly part of the positioning. Do not publish the unverified 1–21 August closure — add an empty seasonal-notice slot in the hours object for the owner to fill.

sections.title: Podnožje — footer
sections.purpose: Close the loop and kill every signal of abandonment the current site broadcasts.
sections.layout: Jadran band. Four columns: SVG logo lockup with the motto; contact block; a short nav echo; legal. The copyright line renders the current year in JS with a static fallback — the live footer's frozen 'Copyright © 2020' is the loudest abandonment signal on the site. Social: Facebook and Instagram (@monami.hr) both linked; the current site links only Facebook despite this being a seafood restaurant with strong plating. A discreet repeat of the HR/EN toggle and the dark-mode switch. The final hairline carries the meridian's terminal node in 0.6875rem tabular-nums — '45,71137° N · 16,07998° E' — the map coordinate as a full stop. Beneath, a cookie-policy link and a note that the site sets no third-party cookies (true, since the Maps iframe is gone), which makes the consent question nearly moot.
sections.copyDirection: Closing line is the motto: 'Restoran Mon Ami — za vas, kao prijatelj prijatelju.' Full address, both numbers (01 6213 333 and 091 5444 715), email. Recommend to the owner a move from monamihr@gmail.com to info@monami.hr — a free Gmail undercuts a €42 beefsteak — but show the real address until that is done.

signatureMoves: The meridian. A 1px vertical hairline runs the full document in the left gutter, background: linear-gradient(to bottom, Jadran-plitko 0%, Maslina 45%, Ulje 100%), with two 5px labelled nodes — 43,81° N SKRADIN and 45,71° N VELIKA GORICA — in 0.6875rem tabular-nums. It is navigation, progress indicator and the entire brand argument in one line. On mobile it becomes a 2px rule under the sticky header, filling left-to-right with scroll.

Subgrid-locked menu. Sixty dish cards in an auto-fill grid where every card is grid-template-rows: subgrid / grid-row: span 3, so dish name, English line and price sit on shared baselines across independent columns — the thing PDF menus and float-based restaurant sites have never managed. Invisible until you notice nothing is ragged.

Photography inversion. Because Mon Ami's own best frames are shot on black reflective surfaces, the page ground is cream and the images are the dark objects. Exactly one section (#ulov) inverts to Adriatic deep — and in dark mode that same section inverts to limewash, so whichever mode you are in the page has precisely one tonal event.

Price honesty as a design element. The €62 / €96 / €63 per-kilogram figures get their own three-card block in 2rem Fraunces tabular-nums with '/ kg — vaga se pred vama' beneath, plus one plain sentence decoding '8–12 kom/kg'. The site's most alarming numbers become its most confident moment.

Twenty photographs nobody has seen. Gallery images 21–40 sit on the server linked from nowhere — the octopus-in-hand portrait (30), the chef plating (25), the scorpionfish diptych (33), the live blue lobster (37), the only dessert shot (40). Half the art direction comes from assets the restaurant already paid for and has never published.

One source of truth for time. A single JS hours object renders the visible day table, computes the live 'Danas otvoreno do 23:00' pill, and emits the schema.org openingHoursSpecification. The Monday short day can never again contradict the general line, because there is only one line.
motion: Meridian scroll-fill. The vertical hairline's gradient reveals on scroll via a ::after whose scale-y is driven by animation-timeline: scroll(root block) with animation-range: 0% 100%. Strictly progressive enhancement — scroll-driven animations are NOT Baseline (Firefox BCD version_added is the literal string 'preview'), so the base rule paints the line fully and only inside @supports (animation-timeline: scroll()) does it start at scale-y(0). Never opacity:0 in a base rule.

Section entrance lift. Each kicker+heading pair rises 1.25rem and fades in on entry with animation-timeline: view() and animation-range: entry 8% cover 32% — remembering that animation-duration is ignored with view timelines, range is the control. Same @supports guard; fully visible without it.

Lightbox morph. Gallery tile to uses a same-document View Transition: assign view-transition-name to the clicked in JS, call document.startViewTransition, clear the name on finish. Guarded by if (document.startViewTransition && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches); otherwise the dialog simply opens.

Dialog entry. The reservation <dialog> fades and rises 0.75rem over 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) using @starting-style plus transition-behavior: allow-discrete on display AND overlay — the overlay entry is what stops a top-layer element vanishing instantly on close. Backdrop transitions from transparent to color-mix(in oklch, var(--kamen) 55%, transparent) with a 6px blur.
Nav underline. Each nav link's 1px Ulje rule animates transform: scaleX(0) to 1 with transform-origin: left over 180ms ease-out on :hover and :focus-visible. GPU-only, no layout, zero INP cost.

Live-status dot. The open-state pill's 6px dot breathes on a 3s ease-in-out opacity 1 → 0.45 → 1 loop. Two lines of CSS, wrapped entirely in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), and the only thing on the page that moves without user input.

Menu category chips. Switching category uses scroll-margin-block-start plus scroll-behavior: smooth (inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference only), and the active chip's Kupa fill cross-fades over a 150ms background-color transition. No JS scroll-jacking — the browser does the scrolling.

Sticky header settle. The header gains its backdrop-filter blur and Rub hairline only once an IntersectionObserver sentinel leaves the viewport, transitioned over 200ms. A state change rather than an animation loop — nothing runs on a scroll event handler.
risks: Image licensing is unresolved. The gallery and O-nama photographs are credited to Josip Škof, Mario Žilec and Jakob Goldstein 'on behalf of Mon Ami'. Being reachable on the restaurant's own server is not clearance. MICHELIN CDN, Gault&Millau, PutniKofer and Eat Out Zagreb images must NOT be hotlinked or copied — reference brief only. Get written confirmation from Bruno Ceronja before launch.

No exterior photograph exists anywhere. There is no verified shot of the building, entrance, signage or the terrace in flower. The inline SVG mini-map partly covers this, but the concept is materially stronger with one commissioned facade frame and one terrace frame. Budget a half-day shoot.

The logo must be redrawn. logo-monami.png has a baked cream wood-grain background and no transparency; sp.png in the live header is a 115-byte spacer with no artwork. No vector original exists on the server. An SVG redraw of the MON AMI wordmark with the plate-O is required work needing the owner's sign-off.

Forty unoptimised JPEGs at 500KB–1.5MB will destroy LCP if shipped as-is. Every image needs AVIF + WebP generation, explicit width/height, responsive srcset, loading=lazy on everything except the hero, and content-visibility: auto on the lower bands. In a single-file no-build deliverable the images must be pre-processed once and referenced — the HTML cannot do it for you.

Prices move and the dossier proves it (carpaccio €16 → €18,50; squid €53 → €62/kg in two years). Hard-coding 60 prices into static HTML guarantees drift. Mitigate by holding all dishes in one JS array at the top of the file, showing a visible 'posljednje ažuriranje' date, and walking the owner through exactly which lines to edit.

Two claims need client verification before publishing: the salmon-with-teriyaki dish MICHELIN singles out does not appear on the restaurant's own published menu, and the chef is 'Goran Marko Beus' on the site but 'Marko Beus' at Gault&Millau. Also avoid asserting a MICHELIN streak number — 'u MICHELIN vodiču od 2018.' is defensible; 'osmu godinu zaredom' is not.

No aggregateRating in the JSON-LD. Google's policy is explicit: self-serving reviews on LocalBusiness/Organization types make the page ineligible for star results. Showing '#1 u Velikoj Gorici' and the 4,8 Google score as plain linked text is fine; putting them in structured data is not. The owner may push for the stars — explain why they backfire.

Bilingual scope limit. A JS-driven HR/EN toggle in one file cannot produce two indexable URLs, so hreflang and per-language canonicals are off the table in v1 and the EN content will not rank independently. Accept this explicitly, set lang="hr" on the document (the current site wrongly declares en-US), update lang on toggle, and flag the two-URL build as phase two.

The owner may resist a cream ground, because every competitor is black and 'premium' has been trained to mean dark. Present the hero mock beside the current empty homepage and beside a black variant — the argument that black swallows their own black-plated photography is the one that wins the room.

Unverified operational facts must stay off the page: the 1–21 August annual closure (single source), parking space counts, wedding capacity beyond 70 seats, and whether online ordering and delivery are even still active. Build slots for each in the hours/facts objects and have the owner fill them on a phone call before launch.
